Name: (FS) My Friend Junimo
Author: thesameplant
Description:
[center][size=5][b]✨ Adds two junimo companion accessories. ✨[/b][/size][/center]
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]


[size=3][b]To install:[/b][/size]
Unzip the file and add it to your Mods folder.﻿
[size=1]The default location on Windows is C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods, but it may vary by operating system. That's just what it is on mine.


[/size][size=3][b]To use in game:[/b][/size]
1. Select the Hand Mirror (which comes with Fashion Sense and can be purchased at Pierre's General Store).
2. Click through the accessory options until you find your junimo friend! There are prismatic and colorable options.


[size=3][b]No configuration is necessary, but if you want to reposition the junimo or change the animation, follow these steps:[/b][/size]
1. Locate the junimo accessory's JSON file.
[list]
[*]Example: /Accessories/ColorableJunimo/accessory.json
[/list]2. To resposition, edit the "HeadPosition", "X" and "Y" values. Positive numbers will move it up, negative numbers will move it down. The "X" values can be edited to move it sideways - positive numbers move it to the right, negative numbers move it to the left. 
[list]
[*]Don't edit the "StartingPosition". This refers to the location of the hair picture within the png file. 
[/list]3. To change the animation:[list]
[*]Open the accessory PNG for reference. (Do not edit the PNG, unless you want to re-draw the image altogether.)
[*]Edit the "Frame" and "Duration" values in the "MovementAnimation", or "IdleAnimation" objects. 
[*]The "Frame" refers to each 16 x 16px section of the png. E.g. frame 0 is the top-left most junimo image. Frame 1 would begin at pixel 16 (on the X axis).
[*]To change the row of junimo images that the frames are being selected from, you would edit the "Y" value of the "StartingPosition". Each row is 16px in height. If you wanted row 2 of the junimo images, you would put 16. Row 3 would be 32, etc.
[*]To make it stay on the same frame for a shorter or longer period of time, edit the "Duration". (I don't know the units. Probably milliseconds.)
[/list]
To test your repositioning while the game is running, use the [code]fs_reload 
[/code]command in your terminal window. This will reload all of your Fashion Sense mods, and you will immediately see the change in your game.
